blocks.x: Grid operators balance physics, markets and regulation in real time: forecasting under intermittency, substation reliability, flexibility orchestration and CIP-grade security. The telemetry-to-decision loop is the core competency of the transition era. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in forecasting and dispatch, asset condition management, der/flexibility orchestration, with cip compliance close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
For Power Generation & Grid, named from the floor, not from a framework:

items: Renewable/demand forecasts legacy; imbalance and curtailment climb.
Transformers/breakers lack condition telemetry; failures unscheduled.
Evidence assembled manually; flat zones persist.
DER flexibility activation by phone/portal; markets underused.
Scheduling formulations exceed solvers; flexibility left unused.
AMI/DER telemetry unharvested; planning blind to edge reality.
